title: France's 5 November strike: what it could mean for air traffic control, and what is still unknown
summary: French unions have called a nationwide strike for Thursday 5 November. Civil-service notices cover DGAC staff, including controllers, but as of 27 October no controller-specific call and no DGAC flight-reduction request had been reported.
